feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: NPR news, audio, and podcasts. Coverage of breaking stories, national and world news, politics, business, science, technology, and extended coverage of major national and world events.

entry.title: Geopolitics and grain don't mix, say these Montana farmers
entry.summary: Farmers in states bordering Canada say they are reeling from President Trump's trade wars and resulting retaliatory tariffs. And it's just not neighborly.

entry.title: SCOTUS rejects Trump's mail voting limits. And, the Kennedy Center financial crisis
entry.summary: The Supreme Court has rejected Trump's mail-in voting restrictions ahead of the midterm elections. And, the Kennedy Center says it is on the brink of bankruptcy and could close soon.

entry.title: Air pollution spiked after the Trump administration stopped embassy monitoring
entry.summary: In 2025, the Trump administration ended a long-running program to collect air pollution data at U.S. embassies. A new study suggests that led to a 24-33% increase in local pollution levels.

entry.title: NATO jets shoot down a drone in Lithuanian airspace
entry.summary: The incident came less than a day after NATO leaders pledged that strikes close to the alliance's territory would drive the trans-Atlantic organization to increase support for Kyiv.

entry.title: For thousands of Haitians in the U.S., end of protected status brings fear, grief and defiance
entry.summary: Haitians in the U.S. lost their Temporary Protected Status under Trump's immigration crackdown. Now facing deportation to a homeland wracked by gang violence, disease and extreme poverty, Haitians in Miami are meeting the moment with grief, anger, and courage.

entry.title: NASA rushed engineers out of their labs. They say it risks future space missions
entry.summary: NASA employees say they've lost vital equipment and staff needed to make sophisticated spacecraft amid the agency's abrupt relocations over the past several months.

entry.title: This bill could reshape crypto in America -- and it's sparking a major battle
entry.summary: The legislation would establish rules of the road for the crypto sector for the first time — but opponents are up in arms, and the bill faces an uncertain prospect in the Senate.

entry.title: Get ready for yet another cost when buying a home: Junk fees
entry.summary: Some real estate agents and researchers say home buyers and sellers should not pay this out-of-pocket fee.

entry.title: Bernie Sanders and Steve Bannon to share a stage to promote curbs on AI
entry.summary: The poles of U.S. politics are coming together over AI. Sanders and Bannon will appear at the "Pro-Human Assembly" in Washington, D.C., to convince Congress to work faster to curb the impact of AI.

entry.title: Supreme Court refuses to allow Trump's mail voting restrictions for the midterms
entry.summary: The Supreme Court has rejected President Trump's push for new mail-in voting restrictions for the midterm election.
